message: Thanks likewise, Nels. Kelly's comment evidenced more graciousness than my initial overstated post deserved, for which I'm grateful to her. I hope she might find the conversation worth continuing. As both she and I have noted, there seems to be a strong epistemological curiosity about intellectual property in composition; a curiosity that's looking for a venue, a focus, and conversants. I'm glad to see people like Becky Howard and Clancy Ratliff shaping the emerging discussion, and I just wish that more people were talking about it. (And so I'm off to Google, in the hopes that Kelly has a weblog of her own to which I might link.)
